title: Sustainable superhydrophobic lignin-based polyurethane foam: an innovative solution for oil pollutant adsorption
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,377-387
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07384C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xinglin Li, Jing Zhang, Hong Liu, Zhiyu Li, Guanfeng Zheng, Ling Zhou, Peng Fu
Lignin-based polyurethane foam was synthesized via a one-pot method and subsequently functionalized with silane to achieve superhydrophobicity. The modified foam demonstrated excellent oil–water separation performance, showcasing its potential for practical applications in environmental remediation.
